items.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials: the effect of potassium-competitive acid blockers on nighttime symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease.
items.journal: Esophagus : official journal of the Japan Esophageal Society
items.summary: Meta-analysis evaluating potassium-competitive acid blockers versus PPIs or placebo for managing nighttime GERD symptoms.

items.title: Randomised clinical trial: comparison of tegoprazan and placebo in non-erosive reflux disease.
items.summary: Phase 3 randomized controlled trial comparing tegoprazan 50mg and 100mg versus placebo in Korean patients with non-erosive reflux disease.

items.title: Management of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease.
items.summary: Comprehensive management guidelines for GERD including empiric PPI therapy, lifestyle measures, and advanced treatment options.

items.title: The Efficacy of Dietary Interventions in Patients with Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Intervention Studies.
items.summary: Systematic review and meta-analysis evaluating the efficacy of dietary interventions on GERD-related outcomes.

items.title: Presentation and Epidemiology of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease.
items.summary: Overview of GERD presentation and epidemiology, noting it as the most prevalent gastrointestinal disorder in the United States.

items.title: Nonablative Radiofrequency Treatment for Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (STRETTA).
items.journal: Gastrointestinal endoscopy clinics of North America
items.summary: Review of nonablative radiofrequency treatment (Stretta) for GERD, evaluating efficacy, mechanisms, and safety data.

items.title: Complications of Antireflux Surgery.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of complications associated with antireflux surgery including wrap disruption, herniation, and adverse events.

items.title: Etiology and treatment options for refractory gastroesophageal reflux disease: A scope review.
items.summary: Scope review examining etiology and treatment options for refractory gastroesophageal reflux disease.

items.title: Cisapride in the control of symptoms in infants with gastroesophageal reflux: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
items.summary: Randomized controlled trial showing cisapride was no more effective than placebo for treating uncomplicated gastroesophageal reflux in infants.

items.title: Double-blind placebo-controlled trial of omeprazole in irritable infants with gastroesophageal reflux.
items.summary: Double-blind placebo-controlled crossover trial of omeprazole in irritable infants with gastroesophageal reflux.

items.title: Efficacy of DA-5204 (Stillen 2X) for patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot study.
